constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

speakers.description: An off-screen narrator, heard only as a voice and not visible on screen.

description.text: A wide, static view holds on an empty railway station platform, keeping the length of the platform and the receding tracks in frame. The platform floor is covered in regular tiles that run toward the platform edge, and a row of supporting pillars stands along the platform, dividing the covered waiting area from the track side. Beyond the edge, the rails stretch away into the distance, and a hanging sign is suspended overhead, displaying the lettering 出口 EXIT 07. No travellers are present, no luggage or activity disturbs the platform, and nothing in the frame moves. The off-screen narrator's voice begins over this still, unpopulated station, with the sign remaining the only visible text.
The empty station platform is held in a wide static view, with tiled flooring, a row of pillars, receding tracks and the overhead sign all visible.

The shot cuts to the same wide, static platform view as a commuter train pulls away along the tracks. The train's carriages slide past the platform edge, gathering distance and receding beyond the end of the platform, while the empty station is left behind in the foreground. The tiled platform, supporting pillars and track-side edge remain fixed in the frame, unoccupied and still after the train has passed. The off-screen narrator's voice finishes over the departing train, and no further lettering appears anywhere in the frame; the moving carriages are the only substantial change in the scene.
A commuter train pulls away along the tracks, its carriages sliding past the platform edge and receding into the distance beyond the end of the station platform.
